entry.name: maxInline
entry.label: How many active app icons sit on the taskbar before the rest go behind the arrow.

entry.name: hiddenItems
entry.label: Status icon ids or titles never shown: desktop plumbing that means nothing to people.

entry.name: iconPlaces
entry.label: Where the person wants each app icon, as JSON: the icon's key to "bar" or "overflow". An icon with no entry follows the app's own status. Settings, Taskbar writes it.

entry.name: seenIcons
entry.label: The app icons there are to choose from, as JSON, for Settings to list: key, title, icon name and whether the icon is on the taskbar now.
